html:
The sacred throne of the Asante, which tradition says Okomfo Anokye called down from the sky about 1701 to settle on the knees of Osei Tutu. It is believed to hold the soul of the nation.

No one sits on it; it rests on its own chair. In 1900 the British governor demanded to sit on it, which set off the War of the Golden Stool led by Yaa Asantewaa. The Asante hid it, and the British never found it. Road workers stumbled on it in 1921 and stripped some ornaments; the Asante tried them themselves. Brought out at great occasions in Kumasi, it is still the centre of Asante kingship.
sum: The sacred throne of the Asante, which tradition says Okomfo Anokye called down from the sky about 1701 to settle on the knees of Osei Tutu. It is believed to hold the soul of the nation.
